reviews.title: Crashes since the update
reviews.text: Love this app, have used it for ages,but I did an upgrade and now it won’t start. Really disappointed.

reviews.title: Such a shame
reviews.text: This used to be simple and worked well. Now the update doesn’t even open. I’m on an iPhone 16s maybe it’s too old. But should be a small simple App. Not sure there’s any point in making it more complex than it needs to be.

reviews.title: Worst app now
reviews.text: Lost all tags already made and now have to pay to add them again, so safe to say I won’t be using the app anymore!!

reviews.title: Was great. But now….
reviews.text: Was great. But since last update whenever I try to add an item from my history back into this weeks list, it tells me it’s already on my list, when it’s not! Now totally useless.

reviews.title: Scam- DO NOT BUY!
reviews.text: Paid for the upgrade and it did nothing. Tried restoring the app, nothing. Tried to report the issue - can’t, tried to contact the developer- can’t. They’ve taken my money and I have no way of getting it back. Gutted as I find the basic version really useful, but I wanted to add a couple of extra lists and instead of continuing to use a great app I’ve been conned out of £9.99 with no way of asking for help.

reviews.title: Update is awful
reviews.text: Same as most recent reviews … £10 or the list is constantly obscured with an advert asking you to upgrade.

reviews.title: Becoming unusable
reviews.text: The only real virtue of this app, which was always a bit clunky but usable, was that it was free. It's pretty much unusable now as the upgrade screen now blocks out your view. I'm going to delete and move on.

reviews.title: Cannot open trolley basket
reviews.text: Today I cannot open the trolley basket to check I have bought everything in there. Instead I find items I have not bought added to the basket so cannot clean up! Is this due to the pop up asking for money. Will have to look for another shopping app or go back to pen and paper. Just impossible to use.

reviews.title: It used to be cubit..
reviews.text: Used this for years but now there is a pop up ad inviting you to upgrade to a paid version. The ad obscures your list so it’s almost obligatory to upgrade, kind of blackmail. Sorry but £10/yr no, not worth it. A one off fee I’d consider. If this doesn’t change, I’m going to look elsewhere….

reviews.title: Unusable- deleted
reviews.text: I used this app for awhile, however the recent update has ruined it and I have removed it from my phone. Sharing lists is now a premium feature, and there is now a large popup asking me to pay for premium covering half the screen when it is in shopping mode. There is no way to close the popup so now the app is unusable. I’m not sure whether this is a recent issue, but I recently noticed that it is unable to categorise lists without an internet connection which is a pretty basic offline function.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: I’ve used this App for a long time and love it. Easy to use, clear lists and ability to share a basic list. I have recommended it to so many people. Sadly not any more.  I’m not sure what the reason for the recent update was but all it’s done has made it unusable.

reviews.title: Upgrade
reviews.text: It’s a good app but constant upgrade add to premium is driving me mad so I’m deleting it …

reviews.title: New Update is Rubbish
reviews.text: Would have given this 4/5 stars previously but now it’s trying to force you to go premium with the ad that blocks the entirety of your list. Won’t bother with it any more.

reviews.title: No longer usable
reviews.text: Just completed my last shop the app is now usable. Go Premium advert now covers most of the shopping list screen! I’ve used this for years and loved it but no more!

reviews.title: Unnavigable
reviews.text: This used to work well but has become too difficult to navigate.

reviews.title: Spoilt app
reviews.text: I have used this app for years, but not anymore, when listing is sorted into categories, I now have Upgrade and Go Premium over half the screen.

reviews.title: Payed premium for nothing
reviews.text:
The app it self is good for free.
But the paid subscription is absolutely bad. It just dosent save the prices. You input the price you can see it when selecting the 3 dots on the product, but when you select the product wipes of the price.

The worst money that i have ever spent

reviews.title: Used to be great. Not anymore.
reviews.text: This used to be a fantastic app. It was intuitive and easy to use. Now, since the last update, the user interface is absolutely awful. It’s clunky and jumpy, everything is harder and it’s just worse in every possible sense. Whoever designed the update woke up and thought ‘how can we make a shopping experience even less enjoyable’ and they really succeeded. Actively looking for a new app to download after I’ve written this review.

reviews.title: Used to be perfect
reviews.text: I used this app for about 5 years and never had any issues. Now with the new update, items disappear from the list, sometimes random ones pop up, the order of items jumble up randomly so it’s hard to keep track of things. The keyboard bounces everywhere and it’s become a 0/10 user experience. Go back to the way it was please. I’m looking for an alternative now 💔💔💔💔💔

reviews.title: Use Apple Reminders Instead
reviews.text:
Used to use this until they added a paywall for coordinating on lists with others
Have since discovered that the out of the box Apple Reminders app does the job better, and it’s free.

reviews.title: Used to be great… then good and now ?
reviews.text: To the app developers- do not release your redesigned app and the updates, until you have tested it in a sandbox..                              My review:  This has been my trusted app for many years and after the recent redesign and updates releases in recent months, it is all but unusable: items disappear randomly…items get duplicated and some items just appear out of nowhere!! So after many years of use, I am sadly, having to look elsewhere

reviews.title: Used to be brilliant
reviews.text:
Used this app for years with my partner, it was fantastic for collaborating, planning and organising. As long as you’ve got your phone, whoever ends up at the supermarket knows what to get.
Now to be able to share the list you have to pay for it? Totally defeats the point. Going elsewhere to look for an app that has the features we need for free.
If it was paid for originally I would have considered it years ago at the time, but making a function that is so so useful only suitable for premium accounts is so money-grabbing I don’t want to give in and pay. Would rather pay for another app.

reviews.title: Why fix it if it isn’t broken?
reviews.text: Can we go back to how it was 3 months ago? It’s was perfect. Every update recently there’s new issues. We don’t need new features or layout. It worked before. It doesn’t now. Items going missing from my list constantly. Irritating

reviews.title: Such a poor upgrade
reviews.text:
I used to love your app and the way my husband and I could share it, adding products to the list which either of us could use when we went shopping.

I am so disappointed with the new app. We add products now and they disappear. Products do not sync with my husband's app and disappear before we remove them.

reviews.title: Very poor update
reviews.text: It used to be possible to add items accurately and very quickly by typing the first few letters of a word and selecting a displayed option.  The new update causes partial entries to be made unless you type out each item in full or select the item from a long table which is equally slow.  As a result I have given up and stopped using it.

reviews.title: Updates have ruined it
reviews.text: This used to be a really simple and very useable app, not a few weeks ago they updated it and ruined almost all of the worthwhile functionality. Products now appear in wrong categories, items you add disappear or have been removed from the directory, the process for ticking items off is now animated and slow. A real shame as this used to be so useful but now it’s just another over designed app that doesn’t do the most basic functionality.

reviews.title: Vibecoded trash deletes items from my list!
reviews.text: Worse than useless after the updates. Deletes items from my list when I try to add new ones on the bottom, making me forget what was meant to be on there. Test changes before you release, please…

reviews.title: Poor app following recent update
reviews.text: My husband and I have been using this app for years on the subscription and it’s been fantastic. We’ve been able to use it with ease no issues. However the recent update (April 2026) is shocking. The keyboard is slow and unresponsive, we can’t get it to sync between our phones anymore and the last time I used it, it deleted my entire shopping list. I’ve no idea why the developers have changed it. Bring back the old version! Don’t fix what isn’t broken! Really disappointed and looking for alternative.

reviews.title: Such a shame
reviews.text: Used to be good but now it’s not really worth it. If you want to share a list you all need to pay for the premium service. Plenty of other shopping list apps out there for FREE you just need to look.

reviews.title: Was great - update changed to much
reviews.text: Used this app for years - was ideal, could edit sections and groups and create your own. Recent update looks totally different and cannot find how to edit and create new categories. Used it and found items missing that put on and groupings were not right and had to move things. Not anywhere near as good as original. Such a shame

reviews.title: Not free to share the list anymore
reviews.text: I used the app for a long time. The sharing the list option used to be free of charge. Following latest update if you want to share the list you have to pay subscription. Time to delete app and look elsewhere

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
I loved this app but it has consistently gone downhill, the new update is awful.
I used to be able to have three lists without subscribing, I deleted one to create a new one and can’t without the subscription, I’m deleting the app and going with a different one that is much more user friendly. Shame this app has gone this way.

reviews.title: Update EVERY DAY
reviews.text:
Recently the app has been updating EVERY DAY, whats going on.

Its a simple basic app that the Notes app could do just as well, if theres one more update I'm deleting

reviews.title: Bring back the old format
reviews.text: The new format is irritating, overly colourful, and a step away from the useful, functional simplicity it had before. It defaults to opening all lists every time, even though I only routinely use 1. There are also a load of lines on the list screen that keep building up and can’t be deleted. I’ll be looking for an alternative.

reviews.title: Shame about the changes- am off to Listonic
reviews.text: Due to the latest update, it has taken away all of the things that made this app so good. Can’t navigate it. Has become confusing. Why change it? So, as a result, I am going to uninstall this app and download Listonic instead. Sorry, Shopping Uk 😞

reviews.title: Sync/Sharing stinks
reviews.text: Not having iCloud sync means I’ll never use this even though in every other respect it is a fine app. The current sync/share system is unreliable and I find I have to reinvite to share  my lists with my other devices. It is simply ridiculous not to have iCloud sync.

reviews.title: New version much worse
reviews.text: I have been using this app for a few years to create grocery shopping lists and loved it. However, the recent update removed what I loved: the possibility of very easily and intuitively recategorizing items, and that of creating my own categories, which are not typical ones, but which I need (such as different shops where I buy certain things, with different stock, so I created my own categories for those). The new version is much less intuitive and easy to use. It seems to have become a meal planner too, which I don’t need. Am uninstalling

reviews.title: Was brilliant until the update
reviews.text: Changes for the sake of changes. The latest update is a significant downgrade. Typing is glitching, shared lists disappeared and a significant downgrade for user experience in general. I have the premium version and it is extremely frustrating that the product I have purchased has been made significantly worse.

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text:
Used this for years, now overnight ridiculously complicated. It’s a Shopping list. What stupid unnecessary nonsense has been added.This app is no longer fit for purpose.
The simplicity was a joy, less is more. I’ll just go back to paper

reviews.title: If it ain’t broke…
reviews.text: Was a great app regularly used but the latest update has ruined it. Will be looking for an alternative now…

reviews.title: Not refreshing to other users
reviews.text: It was a great app but unfortunately lately it has got worse and worse at refreshing and sharing to other people

reviews.title: Shame!
reviews.text: My partner and I have used this for a while and it was great. Now after the recent update you have to pay to share a shopping list and collaborate. iPhone notes can do this but a dedicated app was nice to have. Will be looking for a new one. £10 EACH a year isn’t worth it.

reviews.title: Deleted
reviews.text: Had to delete after I had to subscribe when I had to share  the shopping list with the family

reviews.title: Upgrade
reviews.text: Upgrade doesn’t work unless phone is updated to ios26 which I don’t wish to do. So after several good years with the app, I am cancelling my subscription

reviews.title: No longer free to share list
reviews.text: Worst update ever! I can cope with the annoying ads but forcing people to pay just so that they can add someone else to the shopping list is insane!  It’s a shopping list for crying out loud. You’re not reinventing the wheel!!! Shock horror my other half also does the weekly shop and needs to be able to access the list on his own phone. I may as well go back to using pen and paper like we live in the dark ages

reviews.title: Was great, now awful!
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for years, nice and simple, really helped me!  Now it’s all over the place!  I will be using a notebook and pen!  Bye 👋🏻

reviews.title: Downgrade
reviews.text: Free version allowed users to share the lists, now it’s a paid premium to have this feature. No longer using it.

reviews.title: Not worth paying for!
reviews.text: This app has always had its glitches, but I have put up with it. Now payment is required to share a list I will need to find another way to manage our family shopping. Will not be paying for this option even at £9.99 a year.

reviews.title: Ruined
reviews.text: You have just ruined what used to be a great app. And No I am not going to subscribe. Now looking at alternatives.

reviews.title: Update is appallingly bad
reviews.text: The new update has made the app terrible. I liked the quick and easy to use simplicity of the old version. It was really practical without being unnecessary complicated. The new version is the opposite. It’s too complicated and it’s frankly a pain to use. They’ve made it quite hard to read and make changes to your lists. Sad to say I’ll have to delete it and find a better app.

reviews.title: Has gone massively download
reviews.text:
We used to use this app for several years and it was perfect for our needs. There were a few ads, but they were unobtrusive so didn’t mine.

However, the latest update has refreshed the App and taken away its best feature - the ability to share the list and work collaboratively on it - unless both parties pay £9.99! 

What a rip-off when using a pre-installed Notes app would be free. Admittedly it doesn’t sort items by type automatically, but it would still be free. 

I sympathise that the developers want to make as much money as possible out of this app but the price they expect you to pay doesn’t give enough value for money for what the app is - a simple shopping list.

Very disappointing.

reviews.title: Not user friendly
reviews.text:
Annoying to use without the ridiculous cost.
No better than a pen and paper.

reviews.title: What the hell just happened?
reviews.text: What was a great, easy app to use has now become impossible. I was never going to subscribe to it. It was easy to go through previous shopping trips to compile my weekly list. Now it’s all gone and I haven’t a clue what’s going on with the app now! The designers won’t care that I’ve up and gone as I will not pay a subscription. Au revoir!

reviews.title: Oh dear!!!
reviews.text: What have you done? I love this app and yes, it probably needed some fixes but this is now useless without being able to list items under different shops, gutted!!

reviews.title: Continuously down graded
reviews.text:
This app is being developed in the wrong direction, constant pushing for subscription over demonstrating why we should subscribe to it. You can barely use it now without at least one push for you to sub.

I get it, it costs money to develop and maintain, I’m not against a paid model but the core functionality is getting more fiddly, not less. Then add on the push for subscription, it’s the wrong time to do it.

reviews.title: Hate the update!!!
reviews.text: I never write reviews but I used to love this app. Since the update, it’s horrendous and will now have to look for a new app! So hard to use now

reviews.title: Since upgrade
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for many years and always found it really simple to use. Since the recent revamp it’s impossible to work out, settings are all over the place, and you lose your entire list after every use so have to start from scratch! Will be looking for an alternative now as it’s far too time consuming and over complicated to work out. Very disappointed.

reviews.title: No good
reviews.text: Used to be good but new version is difficult to use

reviews.title: Update disaster
reviews.text: Some programmer has tried to update what was a nice simple app and messed it up completely. All my saved shopping has disappeared and all I get now is my previous list from the last shop I did. Please put it back to how it was and stop trying to get me to upgrade to something I have to pay for.

reviews.title: Avoid now
reviews.text: Made the sharing list function a paid for function now. Cash grab, won’t be using it or paying for it.

reviews.title: New update - what a shame
reviews.text:
Used this app for years and it was great.  The new update has some serious usability issues, making simple things much more effort, like needing to tap each line to edit instead of just pressing delete to go back up a line.

I’ll probably just look for an alternative now.

reviews.title: Downhill fast
reviews.text: My wife & I used this app all the time, why do we need a subscription for a shopping list? Happily pay a once time fee. People do not need another subscriptions especially for a shopping list.

reviews.title: Release 5 is a backward step
reviews.text: There are so many things that are a backward step, I won’t have enough time to write it up. So to start with, why have you removed the ability to edit the list in the list rather than having to edit each line separately?

reviews.title: New update
reviews.text: New update doesn’t work on iPad but works on my iPhone. iPad app opens to an image of phone - similar problem with Tesco app. Thank goodness I’ve still got paper and a pencil.

reviews.title: Update is unusable on iPad
reviews.text: Update is unusable on iPad

reviews.title: Gone downhill
reviews.text: The latest update is a backward step. Why make it more complicated and less useful? AnyList now looks much better. Better still Apple Notes…which is free.

reviews.title: Sharing no longer available
reviews.text: It was great, but it seems in the latest update they have removed the ability to share which is a shame.

reviews.title: Not good snore
reviews.text: As of today, I will be looking for a new website
